# Records written by 3.0.5

`ton-accounts.json` holds TON account records exactly as the 3.0.5 code (commit `129807f0`) writes them to
its `ton` store. Later versions must keep reading them: same address, same public key, same phrase.

The phrases and the password are test-only. One phrase was generated by 3.0.5's own
`generateMnemonic()` (a native TON phrase), the other is the public BIP39 test phrase.

## How it was made

In an unmodified export of the commit (`git archive 129807f0`), with the dependencies of its `yarn.lock`,
this spec was run once with `FIXTURE_OUT=<file> vue-cli-service test:unit --coverage=false`:

```ts
/**
 * @jest-environment node
 */
import fs from 'fs';
import { TonKeyringService } from '../../src/extension/background/extension-base/src/services/keyring-service/TonKeyring';

const written: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];

jest.mock('../../src/extension/background/extension-base/src/stores/TonStore', () => ({
  tonStore: {
    all: jest.fn(),
    set: jest.fn((_key: string, value: Record<string, unknown>) => written.push(value)),
    remove: jest.fn(),
  },
}));

const PASSWORD = 'test-only master password 3.0.5';
const BIP39 = 'abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about';

it('writes TON accounts with 3.0.5 code', async () => {
  const keyringService: any = { getPassword: () => PASSWORD };
  const tonKeyring = new TonKeyringService(keyringService);

  keyringService.tonKeyring = tonKeyring;

  const native = (await tonKeyring.generateMnemonic()).join(' ');
  const accounts = [];

  for (const [kind, phrase] of [
    ['ton-native-24', native],
    ['bip39-12', BIP39],
  ]) {
    expect(await tonKeyring.validateMnemonic(phrase.split(' '))).toBe(true);
    written.length = 0;
    await tonKeyring.createAccount(phrase, `Fixture ${kind}`, PASSWORD);
    expect(written).toHaveLength(1);
    accounts.push({ kind, phrase, stored: written[0] });
  }

  fs.writeFileSync(process.env.FIXTURE_OUT!, JSON.stringify({ password: PASSWORD, accounts }, null, 2) + '\n');
});
```

The `source` block was added by hand afterwards; `password` and `accounts` are the unedited output.
